note: Shock = loss of the leader’s EXPORTS (the redirectable supply). Export-based by construction: a domestic-consuming refiner’s output was never available to importers. Coverage assumes survivors can scale exports up to kappa× current; shared HS codes (gallium/germanium 811292) mix metals, so those rows are a basket.
